T3.design: configuration B, BMS plant: DET-BO with the summer-selected weights (as T1) and a back-off chosen before each period by the scenario rule (largest routed 1-h deficit of the archive) or the robust rule (W dt times the largest routed per-step deficit); walk-forward winter months Nov 2025 - Mar 2026, SoC carried over from the DET-BO chain at the end of October; summer final test, archive the 30 days before it. No tuning: the weights are those of T1.

predictions.P12: Nov-Mar protection hours with the scenario back-off <= those of the re-sized back-off of T1 (7.50 h)
predictions.P13: Nov-Mar protection hours with the robust back-off <= those of the re-sized back-off of T1 (7.50 h)
predictions.P14: Nov-Mar net cost: robust >= scenario >= re-sized back-off of T1 (the back-off is larger in every month)
predictions.P15: Nov-Mar net cost of both above that of UA-MPC
predictions.P16: summer final test: both tie UA-MPC by the label rule of the decision map (protection) and cost more than the re-sized back-off of T1
